tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ mchog dman gyi skyes bu rnams la zhu yig phul ba'i tshogs lhag bsam ngo mtshar sprin gyi bskyed tshal bzhugs/ 498) dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus dkyil 'khor kun gtso padma 'byung*// srid gsum 'gro ba'i blo mun sel phyir slar yang gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te// sku gsum ston pas rgya cher gsungs pa'i zab gsal chos kyi gsang mdzod rnams// khams gsum 'gro la yongs su spel mdzad skyabs gnas mtshungs med gang de'i drung*// snyim pa'i me tog gtsug mtshor bkod de rab dad gus pas 'di skad zhu// khyod sku ngo mtshar nam mkha'i nor bu gzi mdangs mngon par rab bkra zhing*// tshangs dbyangs chos sgra rgyun chad med pas skal ldan yid kyi re 499)ba skong*// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rmad byung mkha' mnyam 'gro la brtser dgongs te// rgyal ba gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub pa'i sti gnas mchog rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i bla ma karma pa sogs bstan pa'i sgron me thams cad kyi// sku tshe mdzad phrin ches cher spel ba'i legs tshogs rten 'brel kun 'grig cing*// rgya chen 'gro ba smin grol la bkod slar yang gnas chen 'od 'bar du// legs par byon zhes snyan pa'i rnga sgra mchog tu grags pa'i cha shas zhig /dben pa'i khang bur gnas pa'i bka' 'bangs bdag 500)'dra'i rna bar legs thos pas// yid kyi dbang po mchog tu dga' ba'i rgya mtsho lhag par 'phel bar gyur// dam pa khyed kyi thugs rje'i drin las bdag cag rnams kyang nad med cing*// ji tsam nus pa'i dge sbyor dag la'ang bar chad med cing bde ba'i ngang*// rje btsun khyod kyi mchog gi mdzad phrin ngo mtshar dpag med mtha' yas la// rjes su yi rangs gus pas 'dud cing mos pas gsol ba 'debs shing mchis// slar yang mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs don gyi snying po ru// mkha' khyab 'gro dang khyad par bdag sogs gdul bya'i don la rab dgongs te// sku tshe'i 'du byed bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa dang*// gang 'dul smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa bskor mdzad cing*// dmigs pa med pa'i brtse ba chen pos bdag sogs rnams la gzigs su gsol// mgon po khyed la dngos 'byor zang zing

501)mchod pa'i yo byad ma mchis kyang*// 'di dang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge kun ma gyur 'gro la yongs bsngo ba'i// lhag bsam rab dkar 'dab stong rgyas pa rtag tu mchod par 'bul lags na// thugs rjes bzhes la bdag kyang khyed bzhin rgyal kun phrin las myur grub shog/ ces pa 'di mtshungs bral 'ja' mtshon snying po'i zhabs drung du zhu yig phul ba'o// ༈ dpag med sngon nas sbyangs ba'i las 'phro sad// dam pa'i rjes zhugs yang dag gdams pa lon// sgrub pa mthar phyin rang gzhan don 'grub pa'i// skyes mchog nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gang de la// ring mo'i sa nas spro bas 'di skad gsol// deng dus sgo gsum rdo rje gsum ldan ngang*// thos bsam blo gros nam mkha'i khyon yangs par// rim gnyis zab gsal nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// smin grol gdams pa'i 'od zer legs spros pas// gdul bya'i blo yi mun sel mchog gyur te// ye shes snang 502)ba 'od kyis yongs khyab tshe// bsod nams stobs kyis dregs pa'i rgyal po dang*// rang 'dod khengs pa'i bla dpon du ma yang*// khyod kyi rig grol yon tan gzi 'od la// 'gran par ma nus slar yang btud gyur cing*// rgyal bstan snying po snga 'gyur rdo rje'i theg /chos kun mthar thug rdzogs pa chen po yi// bstan pa'i srog shing mi nub rgyal mtshan dang*// snang byed sgron me dam par gyur zhes pa'i// snyan pa'i grags chen dbyar skyes rnga sgra ni// phyogs 'dir thos pas yid kyi re skongs shing*// shin tu smad byung ngo mtshar dga' ston nyid// mchod 'os kun la mchod pa'i mchog gyur cing*// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba legs byas pa'i// khyod kyi dam pa'i spyod la bdag yi rang*// dus mthar skyes pa'i bla gzugs bdag 'dra ni// sgyu ma'i lus la nyer 'tshe med ngos nas// 'du 'dzis dben pa'i bsam gtan khang bu ru// dam chos spyod la yid smon tsam du gnas// slad

503)du'ang rgyal sras dam pa khyod nyid kyi// ngo mtshar mtha' yas chos kyi phrin las ni// nam mkha'i mthar khyab 'gro ba'i khams kun la// yongs su khyab mdzad brtson pa'i shugs skyed mdzod// snyigs dus gdul dka'i sems can 'gro don dang*// bskyangs yang mgu dus med pa'i 'khor slob dang*// ngo bsrung chags sdang spel ba'i yon bdag rnams// rang don rlag pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur gsungs kyang*// bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar 'dul khrims dang*// rgyal ba'i mdzad srol sems bskyed go cha gnyis// gang byung lam khyer gsang sngags zab gnad gsum// mi 'bral rgyud la gom pa'i skyes bu la// rang gzhan don kun lhun grub smos ci dgos// snang grags chos kun sems su ro gcig pa'i// rang byung rang rig gsal stong zung du 'jug /'khor 'das dbyer med gdod ma'i gnas lugs la// dgag sgrub spong len byas pa'i dgos pa ci// snang srid ye 504)nas yongs dag bde chen zhing*// sna tshogs 'gro ba lha dang bla ma'i ngang*// bzang ngan legs nyes rang rig rtsal nyid las// sangs rgyas sems can logs su grub med phyir// ris med 'gro la phan pa lhur blangs shing*// 'gyur med dad pas bla ma rang sems bsres// sgom med yengs med mtha' bral ka dag don// dpag med dge ba'i gshegs shul yang dag nyid// mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi snying po mchog /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang la// rang nyid 'jug cing gzhan dag legs 'khrid pa'i// dam pa'i don mchog nyid la 'bad par mdzod// sgyu ma'i skyes bu gtad med bdag 'dra yis// skyes mchog khyed la dge ba'i sems kyis ni// legs bshad zab mo'i nor bu skyes su bskur// chos dbyings klong du rol ba'i dga' ston mdzod// de ltar legs par gdams pa'i dge ba'i mthus// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid mtsho las thar nas// rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang

505)mchog zhugs te// gdod ma'i dbyings su mngon sangs rgyas par shog/ ces pa 'di bla ma grub chen pa tshe dbang mtshan can la bskur pa'o// ༈ skyabs kun gyi mchog gyur padma 'byung*// zhabs pad la spyi bos btud byas nas// yongs 'dzin gyi bshes gnyen gang de yis// ngo mtshar gyi yi ge zhib 'khod dang*// lha rdzas kyi skyes gnang phun tshogs bcas// bka' drin du bstsal ba'i gdab lan du// snying gtam gyi gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bum// zab don gyi bcud kyis yongs bkang ba// lhag bsam gyi bzhon pas legs drangs te// don ldan du phul gyis dgyes par mdzod/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus legs thob cing*// theg mchog gi bstan dang mjal dus 'dir// don ldan du phul gyis dgyes par mdzod// dal 'byor gyi mi lus legs thob cing*// theg mchog gi bstan dang mjal dus 'dir// don chen gyi snying po bsgrub dgos pas// de phyir du 'di ltar nyams len 'tshal// rang lus 'di yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// spyi gtsug tu rigs bdag bla ma mchog 506)/pad 'byung ngam rdo rje 'chang chen nam// bla ma nyid dngos sam gang mos gsal// snang srid kyi dngos por gyur tshad dang*// bdag lus dang longs spyod sgo gsum kun// ltos med du mchod par phul byas la// rtse gcig tu mos gus drag po yis// rgyun ldan du gsol 'debs bdag la 'bad// bla ma las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs// tshangs bug nas lus nang thams cad khyab// dngos grub kun yongs rdzogs thob bsam zhing*// bar skabs su bla ma rang sems bsre// spros bral gyi rang sems dri med la// dgag sgrub kyi lhad kyis ma bslad par// bzo med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /don dam gyi bla ma chos sku dang*// dbyer med du rang zhal mjal ba lags// rjes thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du// bla ma nyid spyi bor 'bral med dang*// smra brjod kun gsol 'debs kho nar dmigs// bsnyen

507)bsgrub kyi dam pa nyid du 'gyur// 'gro dus su g.yas kyi nam mkhar bsgom// bskor ba la rgyun chad med pa'o// zas za tshe mgrin par bsgom zhing mchod// tshogs chen gnyis lhun gyis rdzogs pa yin// nyal ba'i tshe snying gi dbus bzhugs bsam// 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag mchog tu 'gyur// 'chi ba'i tshe spyi bor bsgom byas la// rlung rig kun bla ma'i thugs kar gtad// 'pho ba'i mchog gyur de la 'bad// gdon bgegs kyi cho 'phrul byung ba na// 'dre gdon kyang bla ma'i sprul par mos// lus srog kun 'phangs med tshogs su 'bul// gcod yul gyi nyams len mthar thug yin// nad byung na na sar bla ma yi// sku phra la dod pa gsal ba las// bdud rtsi babs nad kun dag par bsam// ro snyom gyi gdams ngag khyad par 'phags// mdor bsdu na rgyal ba sras bcas kun// dbyer med du bla mar 508)ro gcig pas// de nyid la blo rtse gcig dril na// gnas skabs dang mthar thug dgos 'dod kun// 'bad med du lhun grub 'byung 'gyur bas// tshul 'di la rtag tu 'bad pa gces// mdo rgyud dang man ngag bsam 'das shing*// gsar snying sogs gzhung lugs grangs med kyang*// dgongs bzhed kun gcig tu mthun pa yi// rgyal sras kun bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// zab don gyi snying po 'di nyid la// chig dril du nyams su blang bar bya// gcig mchog gi don la ma 'bad na// shes shes kyi tshig tshogs brgya yod na'ang*// dgos dus su phan pa gcig mi 'byung*// gnad don gyi rtsa ba gcod par 'tshal// snyigs dus kyi bla gzugs bdag 'dra yang*// thos bsam gyi sbyangs pa ma byas pas// lung rig gi rnam bshad mi shes kyang*// lam zab 'di bla ma'i drin las thob// yid ches kyi myong ba grub pa'i phyir// khyed nyid kyang 'di bzhin nyams bzhes 509)zhu// de ltar du gdams pa dge ba'i mthus// mkha' mnyam gyi ma rgan sems can rnams// 'khrul snang gi gzeb las yongs grol te// don dam gyi bla ma'i sa non shog/

ces pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ snga 'gyur snying po'i bstan la mchog tu gus pa bla ma brtson 'grus mtshan la smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling nas phul ba // ༈ rig grol dpal yon ldan pa gang de yi// gsung shog bcud ldan snying po'i rten dang bcas// ku sā li pa kho bo'i gan nyid du// legs par smin pas mchog tu spro ba 'phel// bdag kyang sgo gsum nus stobs ci mchis kyi// bstan pa'i bya ba bsgrub par sems mod kyang*// dus ngan rlung gi dge blo'i mar me bskyod// bstan pa'i snang ba gsal bar ma gyur tshe// bdag 'dras dben kyang ngal ba don med las// bden pa'i mal du rang sems gnyug ma'i 510)don// sgom med ngang las ma yengs tsam gnas pa// bstan 'gro'i don du 'di ga phan nam snyam// spros bcas las la mi tshe bskyal byas shing*// de las byung ba'i zang zing bsdus pa yis// ser gzugs can gyi skye bo 'ga' tshogs sar// bstan par rlom 'di sems kyi ma rangs so// tshe 'di yud tsam nam mkha'i glog 'dra la// bskal brgyar sdod 'dra'i grabs shom 'di byed cing*// chos gzugs byas nas 'khor ba'i las spyod pa'i// gang zag mthong tshe sems kyis ma bzod kyang*// bag chags ngan pa'i stobs shugs dbang btsan zhing*// log spyod dus kyis brlabs pa'i skye 'gro la// phan pa'i sems kyis legs pa'i lam bstan zhing*// dam chos 'dun ma snying nas bshams na yang*// mi nyan log lta skye ba kho nar gyur// 'di lta'i dus tshe shes ldan skyes bu dag /g.ya' spang gangs ri nags khrod dben pa ru// 'du 'dzi g.yeng spangs dam chos spyod pa la// bdag 511)kyang mchog tu smon zhing yi rangs thob// 'on kyang theg chen dam tshig yin pa'i phyir// rim gyis bstan la gang phan bya ba dag /tshe yi lhag ma ji tsam thub kyi bar// gang nus bgyid pa'i sems skyed smon lam 'tshal// khyed kyang rang gzhan mkha' mnyam sems can la// phan bde'i slad du sems skyed rnam dag pas// lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor rim pa la// g.yel ba med par brtson par mdzad 'tshal zhing*// slar yang 'o skol myur tu mjal nas kyang*// zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i khang bzang du// bde chen chos kyi dpal la longs sbyod pa'i// bslu med rten 'brel bzang po'i mtshams sbyor bgyi'o//

zhes pa 'di slob dpon ratna'i mtshan can gyis rang nyid la sha tsha'i yi ge bskur ba'i lan du smin grol skyed rdzogs gling gi mtshams mal nas phul ba'o// ༈ mi dbang dam pa'i rgyud las sku 'khrungs shing*// legs bshad yon tan nor gyis 512)rab brgyan pa// dad ldan kun bzang chos rgyal gang de yis// dbang po'i gzhu 'dra'i lha rdzas skyes bskur te// skyes lan snying gtam gdams ngag dgos so skad// khyod ni lung rtogs dam chos 'byor pas phyug /bdag ni thos bsam sgom pa'i nor gyis dben// legs bshad yon tan sbyin par nus min kyang*// gong ma'i gsung rgyun tsam la brten nas ni// snying gtam thar pa'i lam bzang 'di ltar bstan// rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen legs thob cing*// sangs rgyas bstan dang bshes gnyen 'dzom dus 'dir// rin chen gling nas stong log ma byed par// nam bzhag gtan gyi mdun ma bsgrub par 'tshal// tshe 'di mi sdod ri gzar 'bab chu 'dra// skyes pa'i mtha' ma 'chi las ma 'das shing*// 'khor ba gar skyes sdug bsngal bsngal me 'obs 'dra// long med brtson pas thar pa bsgrub par 'tshal// de nyid bsgrub pa'i gzhi rten dam pa ni// bslab gsum sdom pa rin chen go cha 513)ste// mig 'bras lta bur gces spras bskyang byas nas// bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin la 'bad par 'tshal// de steng rgyal ba'i lam srol rmad byung ba// theg chen snying po byang chub sems nyid mchog /gzhan phan bsgrub la brtson pas shugs bskyed de// sgo gsum dge las g.yo med bgyid par 'tshal// de steng lam gyi lam mchog snying po'i don// snang grags lha sngags rtog tshogs chos nyid klong*// 'khor 'das rig pa'i rol par la zlas te// skyed rdzogs dbyer med don la 'bad par 'tshal// de las gzhan pa'i dus rnams thams cad du// spyi bo'i gtsug tu drin can bla ma nyid// 'bral med rgyun du sgom zhing gsol ba gdab// nyams len snying po 'di la dril bar 'tshal// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba sems can ma lus kun// rang gi pha mar ma gyur gang yang med// de dag byang chub lam la 'god

514)slad du// spros bcas spros med dge la 'bad par 'tshal// skyabs gnas rnams la 'bral med dad gus dang*// rigs drug kun la tshad med snying rje dang*// thams cad yongs la phyogs med dag snang ste// de dag rnams la mi 'bral bgyid par 'tshal// mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos thams cad kyi/ dgongs don zab mo hril gyis dril ba'i gnad// rgyal sras mtha' dag bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// 'di las med pas thugs la gzhug par 'tshal// chos kun mdo 'gag gnad du dril byas nas// rang gi rgyud thog khel bar mi byed par// shes shes mang yang dgos dus phan pa nyung*// nyams len snying por dril la brtson par 'tshal// legs bshad 'di ya'i dge ba gang de'i mthus// mtha' yas 'gro ba srid par 'khyams pa kun// blang dor gnas la ma nor lhur len zhing*// go 'phang mchog la myur du reg par shog 515)

ces pa 'di chos mdzad kun bzang chos rgyal la gdams so// ༈ mtha' bral ka dag klong yangs kyi pho brang nas// rig stong rang byung ye shes chos kyi rgyal pos/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi gtam/ gu ru rin po che padma thod phreng gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbas pa'i gnas chen mkhan pa ljongs kyi gnas bdag gi rigs/ phyi yi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ nang gi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ gsang ba'i rnam rtog 'khu phrig la sogs snang srid kun la bzlo ba/ snang grags thams cad ye gdod ma nas dag pa rab 'byams yin pa la/ blo bur 'khrul snang 'gyu ba spun pos bdag gzhan gnyis su bzung bas bar chad thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin mod cing*/ da phyin chad rnal 'byor pa 'di dag ka dag blo 'das chos nyid mngon sum gyi don sgom pa la/ mtshan 'dzin yengs 'khrul gyi gegs ma byed par chos nyid zad sar 'khyol ba'i gdong grogs mthun rkyen 516) bsgrub pa la 'bad pa gal che/ zhes sgom med kyi lo/ yengs med kyi zla ba'i dus dge bar/ ma bcos lhun grub kyi pho brang nas bris pa dge legs 'phel// zhes pa 'di rnal 'byor pa gar dbang 'od gsal rang grol sbas yul mkhan pa ljongs kyi gnas chen du bsgrub pa la 'gro ba'i tshe/ bar chad sel ba'i bka' shog dgos zer bar sbyin pa'o// ༈ sa gsum gtso bo 'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang po gang*// rin chen 'khor lo yang dag dbang bsgyur chos kyi rgyal// shar phyogs dge legs snang ba gsal mdzad bsod nams gter// mi dbang gser gyi lhun po lta bu'i zhabs zung pad/ 1 /'chi med na chung brgya phrag stong*// zur phud dpal gyis legs bsten lha// spyan stong mnga' bzhin rtsibs stong gi /mtshan ma bkra shis mchog 'bar khyed/ 2 /rnam dag byang chub dam pa'i sems bskyed gru// tshogs gnyis dge ba'i ba dan bskyod mthu dang*// lhan cig bde dga'i dpal 'byor rin chen gling*/

517)/dbang 'byor mi yi lha de'i zhabs drung du/ 3 /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon yangs kyi// bye brag chu lha mo'i lang tsho// mchog gsal kong mthil ljon pa'i tshal// grub dbang padma'i zhabs ris bkra/ 4 /thub bstan lha lam yangs pa'i dbyings rum nas// snga 'gyur 'od gsal snying po'i nyi gzhon 'bum// shar ba'i cha shas lhag ma cung zad kyi// dpal la nyer spyod 'dus pa'i tshogs dpung nas/ 5 /ngo mtshar gzhon nu rol pa'i gar// bstod dbyangs mgrin pa'i rgyud mang gi /snyan tshig akṣa ra'i gzugs su// rab dkar shing shun me long ngos/ 6 /lhag bsam dri bzang 'phro ba'i ku muttas// legs bklubs nyams 'gyur brgya yi rol rtsed bcas// grags 'byor bsod nams mthu stobs do ra der// sa skyong dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rol mor 'bul/ 7 /gang gi thugs bskyed zla gsar 'dod 'jo'i dpal// mngon gsal mi zad rgya chen dge ba'i skyes// nyi 'og thub bstan 'dzin sde mtha' dag par// khyab bstsal bka' yi sgrom bcas 'dir yang son/ 8 /e ma e 518)ma 'khor bsgyur dge ba'i dpal// srid 'byor grags stobs mthu dpal khyon yangs par// mtshar ci dpag med sngon gom 'gro mang slad// rin chen bstan zhabs 'degs 'dir gus yi rang*/ 9 /rab zab rgya chen chos sgo'i bstan// ris med ral pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi// yang dag tog tu gzi 'bar ba'i// yon tan rnam par 'chang mkhas mchog 10 /gang sku'i mthu stobs dpal las legs grub pas// zla bral byang chen mchog rgyu'i dge rtsa 'dis// mngon mtshan nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan kun// srid gnas duḥkha'i mtsho las myur grol gyi/ 11 /smon lam gaṅga'i ji snyed sangs rgyas gsungs// rjes 'brang bdag sogs 'dus par bcas pas kyang*// mngon zhen dri ma spangs pa'i lhag bsam gyis// yongs bsngo zag med 'bras mchog mngon gyur gyi/ 12 /slad mar nam yang yang dag dge 'bras dang*/

519)/lhan cig dpal 'byor 'byor pa'i rgya mtsho yi// stobs dang nyid sku sku tshe'i lhun po ni// nam mkha' ji srid srid 'dir rab brtan shog/ 13 ces pa 'di 'jang sa ngam rgyal po'i bka' shog gi 'phrod lan du phul ba'o// ༈ rab 'byams rigs brgya gsang chen rigs gcig ni// snying po rigs 'dus bla ma he ru ka /srid dang zhi ba'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// bskal brgyar nges gsang chos 'khor bskor du gsol// mi 'gyur gzhom med sku yi lhun po gang*// rab brtan theg mchog nyi 'od gdal mdzad pa'i// rdzu 'phrul rmad byung dakṣi ṇya phyogs kyang*// de bzhin rnam rol phrin las kun dga'i gter// 'gro ba 'dul mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs pa'i// skabs su'ang snyan grags skabs gsum grong*// khyab gyur rigs kun khyab bdag che// nges don snying po'i snyan ngag rol gar gzugs 520)/dkar 'jam shog bu'i do rar mngon gsal ba// du ku li yug lhab lhub g.yo bar bcas// kong rong ljon pa'i gling zad bas mthar son// rab zab bka' yi glegs bu brgya// mi bshig rdo rjes legs btab pa'i// byin rlabs sprin gyi go bar las// dngos grub zim bus blo kha phyes// 'di na lnga brdo dar ba'i ngang tshul la// yid rab byung zhing gzhan phan bya ba'i phyir// rab brtul rang sems tsitta'i ga'u ru// bskum ste yid las chung ngur gzhol bzhin mchis// rmad byung mkhyen brtse'i mthu stobs dpal// mchog ldan rje btsun rig 'dzin snying*// gang gi phrin las yal 'dab pa'i// 'gro la rtag tu khyab mdzad shog/ ces mtshungs med rig 'dzin snying po'i drung du phul pa'o// ༈ ma lus chos kun gdod nas rang bzhin gyis// rnam dag ro mnyam chen por dbyer med pa'i// 'gags med 'od gsal lhun grub 'bras bu'i bon/ 521)/smin grol 'od stong 'gro la 'gyed mkhas pa// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin// nam mkha' bsod nams 'phrin las gter// nam mkha' bsod nams gdul bya'i don// nam mkha' mnyam pa gang de'i drung*// srid pa me 'ob lta bu'i btson ra la// mngon par skyo ba'i nges 'byung bsam pa ni// yang yang 'dus byas rkyen tshogs kyis bskul te// dben la dga' ba bdag 'dras 'di skad gsol// khyed sku gzi bar nyi ma 522)sig bcas phyag rtags kyi// 'ching ba ma nyams 'di na smin// rgyal ba'i lung bstan dus bab pa'i// rang tshul mngon sum snying las ches// snyigs ma'i bstan 'gro nyams thag pa'i// rnam 'gyur kyi hud yid rab byung*// de slad bstan 'gro'i don du ming btags pa'i// rang gzhan g.yeng khrod dal 'byor chud gzan la// ma rangs kong yul tha dag zad pa'i nags// dben par kun spangs spyod pas 'tsho bzhin mchis// nam 'chi cha med lang tsho'i me tog yal// gzhan don re bral dgon sde'i 'khur po bor// mi khyu nas bros blo phugs sprang la gtad// gcig pur ri la 'chi ba bdag smon lags// rig 'dzin mchog nyid sku yi lhun po gang*// bskal brgyar rab brtan chos char 'gro la 'bebs// ma lus 'gro ba'i don chen rab grub cing*// 'og min gnas su lhan cig mjal bar smon// 523) ces bon lugs kyi bla ma rig 'dzin nam mkha' bsod nams la phul ba'o// ༈ 'dud do rgyal ba kun bdag lha yi lha// mi dmigs mnyam pa chen po'i thugs rje yis// gzigs pa phyogs lhung bral yang bdag gcig don// kho nar 'tsho zhing bzhes 'dra'i pha mchog drung*/ 1 /ma rig 'khrul 'khor zad med 'phel med 'gro// mang 'di theg mchog shing rtas thar gling du// kha lo bskyod la ngal med rnam 'dren khyod// gdul bya mgrin sngon ral spor sku'i zla snang*/ 2 /nyin dang mtshan gsal dmar phyogs mi mnga'i 'od// kong nag mun chen khrod kyang lam me bar// snang mdzad tshad med thugs rje'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// bdag blo'i mun chen gzhom dang dad kunda/ 3 /rgyas gyur lhan cig mdzad nus e ma mtshar// gzhom bral sku dang tshangs dbyangs zab mo'i gsung*// bri gang las 524)'das thugs rje'i 'dod 'jo yis// da dung phyi ma'i mu mthar bskyang mdzad gsol/ 4 /'di na rang rgyud byin rlabs brlan// dben dang gzhan rgyud ko skam chos// snum dred khyer ba'i skyon ngang tshul// mthong khyod mi smra'i brtul zhugs las/

5 /thabs bral rta zhon ber gyon gyis// nor ldan yan lag mchog 'khor lo// bsgyur ba'i mnga' thang sngon ji bzhin// slan chad 'byung bar ma gyur cig 6 /dge blo'i bag chags gla rtsi'i khog dri tsam// med legs bsnan gang*// lam ring bgrod dka'i nyer 'tshes ma bcom par// 'chugs med kong mthil dpal ri gangs kyi 'dabs// rgod tshang brag phug dben pa'i mtshams mal du// 'byor bas ngo mtshar 'dab brgya gyes 529)/mngon shes rju 'phrul lha mthong 'dre mthong rigs// dus min lung bstan 'gro don bskul ba sogs// lha bu'i bdud kyis bslus na bslu tshabs che/ chos pa bub pa'i 'phrang la 'di nyid 'jigs// rang ma rang mdangs 'char tshul du// las nyon gong bu'i mi rgan bdag 'dra bar// byang chub bar gyi skyabs gnas gyis shig ces// rgyal ba'i sku brnyan ngo mtshar phung po ni// ngo chen tshul du bstsal zhing bka' mchid 'phreng*// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po la sbrel nas// nan tan gnang ba tsitta'i ga'ur thim/ 534)/spyir yang dman pas mchog skyobs mi srid cing*// ldongs pas mig ldan khrid pa'i yul min 'chams zhog long dang*// kha gsag ngo bsrung tshul 'chos mgron skyong la// bstan pa'i zhabs tog sems can 'gro don zhes// ming snyan du mar btags pa'i g.yo khram la// nan gyis sbyor ba'i grwa 'khor

543)sbyin bdag dbus// dkor nag rba rlabs gnam du 'phyur ba la// dga' ba'i ca co 'byin pa'i dpon slob kun// rang rgyud chos brgyad chang gis rab myos pas// ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'khyor bas skyi g.ya' za// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i gdams ngag las// chang phor gang nyid 'dams pa'i grwa slob la// rang phyogs yin zhes zhen rus ci byas kyang*// be'u sbrel g.yang la 'chong thabs 'ba' zhig nyid// gang du phyin yang bsngos sha'i bsnyen bkur dang*// chos gos rnam gsum chang gis bangs pa'i khrod// rnyed bkur 'tshol ba'i rnam 'dren gzugs brnyan de// byas la 'gyod cing mi byar smon lam 'debs// dal 'byor lan cig khe gyong so mtshams 'dir// 'khor bar gtan 'khyams sgrub la mi ngal bzhin// chos phyir nyin gcig tsam gyi 544)dka' spyad kyang*// mi nus lto gos don la rings par rgyug /rang sems nang du skad cig mi khug par// gzhan mgo skor phyir rnga brdung dril 'khrol sogs// rnam 'gyur brgya phrag byed pa'i don 'bras te// sgyu ma'i nor nyid sems mod 'chi khar 'gyod// de bas sgrub brgyud rjes rnyegs la gdung ba// skom chu 'dra yang rang dbang ma thob lus// bstan 'gro'i 'pho 'gyur tshe 'dis rkyen byas pa'i// drin las mtha' khob phyogs 'dir thar ba lags// da ni lang tsho'i me tog dus kyis rnyid// kha so'i gral zhig mgo skyes dkar mdangs thon// mi tshe'i nyi ma nub ri'i phrag par babs// de phyir zang zing la dga'i spros pa zhi// dkor gyi grib lhongs drag po'i nus pa ni// mngon sum myong ba'i zug rngu la ltos na// shi nas ci tsam 'byung ba nyams 'og tshud/ 545)/skye ba gzhan du'ang dkor zan mi skyer smon// de phyir rnam 'dren khyed kyang bdag 'dra la// brtse bas zang zing gnang bar ma mdzad par// gdul bya'i grwa slob kun kyang zhen log dang*// nges 'byung mos gus lam la dkri bar mdzod// rtsod ldan grub mtha' kun spyod 'di 'dra la// nyer dgongs sgrub brgyud yang rtse 'brug pa'i srol// zhen log snying rus gsol 'debs rlung phyag gis// skal bzang skye rgu'i dal 'byor don ldan mdzod//

ces zhu yig gi 'degs byed zang zing dri mas dben par/ bka' gsar rnying gi dad rten khungs thub 'ba' shig gong bur bgyis pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman rten 'dus ril bur bcas pa'i phyi thum la mi bshig rdo rje'i rtags kyis bkra ba zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la ri khrod nas phul ba'i zhu yig// ༈ skye nas skye bar bka' brgyud bstan pa dang*// zla 'od gzhon nu'i phrin las sgrub 546)pa la// g.yel med mthu stobs bstan 'dzin dbang po'i sde// sku tshe phrin las chos srid 'phel gyur cig gang gi bka' tham lha rdzas khyad 'phags dang*// ro 'dzin tshim byed rkang 'thung myu gu'i bcud// mi gzhig phyag rgya'i 'ching ba ma nyams par// mi rgan tshe srog bsring ba'i rten gnang smin// mchid len med kyi gdung sel bskur zhig pa'i// bka' yig rmongs rgan thod du rab bcings nas// mi shes bzhin du g.yar khral tshig 'ga' tsam// gsol 'di bsam pa dkar po'i me tog lags// ༈ kye lags/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i yang snying sgrub brgyud kyi// srog shing 'gyur med mdzad pa'i khur chen de// skyes mchog nyid kyi phrag par babs lags kyi// dge blo'i thugs stobs bskyed par yang dag gsol// rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob gnas med phyir// yon tan gzhi ma yi 547)ge'i rigs mtha' dag /sgra tshad bzo gso snyan ngag sdeb sbyor rtsis// shes bya'i gnas kun thogs med mkhyen gzigs 'tshal// de las khyad par nang don rig pa'i mchog /mdo rgyud lung dang bstan bcos man ngag bcas// grub mtha' phyogs rer ma lhung yongs rdzogs la// sgro 'dogs gting nas chod pa'i nges ldan zhu// khyad par bla med rdo rje'i theg pa'i bcud// sgrub rgyud rig 'dzin tshar du dngar rnams kyis// gshegs shul bgrod pa gcig pa'i smin grol don// thugs kyi rgyud la thim zhing 'dres nges zhu// de yang nyams len nyid la rag lus shing*// nyams len byin rlabs zhugs la ltos pa dang*// byin rlabs bla mar rag phyir skyabs gnas mchog

/mnyes pa gsum gyis ngal med bsten mdzad zhu// de las thon pa'i 538)zhal gyis bdud rtsi la// nges shes dad pa'i snying phur legs btsugs nas// skyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa nus thon du// rang don brtsan sa zin zhing gdengs thob zhu// de tshe bar chad mtshan ma gang dang ci// byung yang phyag rgya chen po'i rdzong bzung ste// cir snang sems dang sems nyid chos sku ru// thag chod re dogs 'ching ba bcad mdzad zhu// rang don mngon gyur sgrub rgyud rin po che'i// pha rabs zin tshe gzhan don ma lus pa// nam zla dros pa'i rtsi thog ji bzhin du// 'bad med lhun grub nyid du 'byung ba lags// de ltar chos don mdo tsam gsol lags kyi// 'jig rten shes sgo bdag la ma mchis pas// gsol ba'i don med shes kyang ci zhig bya// de phyir 'di tsam dgongs pa'i dbyings bcags zhu// zhes zhu yig gcer bu min tsam gyi lha rdzas 549) dang*/ byin rlabs dam rdzas khungs btsun phur ma'i phyi tshas la mi bshig rdo rje'i rtags zhus bcas/ rgyal ba mchog gis rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul mngon par bstan pa'i dus bzang la/ chos dbyings 'od gsal rtsa'i ri khrod mtshams mal nas/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi ming tsam 'dzin pa'i bya bral ba rgan pos phul ba'i zhu yig/ ces pa 'di sgam po gdung brgyud zhabs drung mthu stobs bstan 'dzin dbang por phul ba'o// ༈ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing gi ston pa kun// 'gro khams mos pa'i chu snod so so yi// skal ngor snang mod mtha' dag khyed gcig pu'i// sgyu 'phrul ye shes snying po'i bsil zer can// thog med ma rig mun nang gtan 'khyams pa'i// dmus long dmigs bu bral ba bdag sogs 'gror// thugs rje'i snang ba ster mkhas lha yi lha// zhabs sen rnyog med bde chen 550)'khor lor bkod// sgo gsum gtan gyi 'dun bcas mchod sprin du// dmigs med dmigs pa'i zlos gar chen po yis// ji srid bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ri mo 'di// ma zhig de srid 'bul bzhes brtser dgongs gsol// gang yang nam mkha' gar khyab gdul bya'i tshogs// ma lus lag mthil skyu ru ra bzhag bzhin// sgrib med mkhyen gzigs skyob pa'i phrin las la// chags thogs med pa sangs rgyas spyi'i chos nyid// yin kyang rang skal byang lta'i bya skyibs can// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rigs mthun mtha' yas rnams// khyed zhal nyi 'od mthong bar ma nus la// skyo dang gdung dang rang la yi chad mos// 'on kyang rang sems dkar ba'i ā darsha// cha shas sgrib med gtsang mar khyed thugs rje'i// sgyu 'phrul dad pa'i pir gyis gsal bkod nas// nya rgyas zla

551)ba'i dod por bsten bzhin lags// de tshul lkog gyur gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan// bdag lta'i dman la'ang ched du gtod mdzad pa// gang gi byin rlabs gzi 'bar bka'i glegs bu// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter gtams gtsug pad phebs// mgo skyes dkar por rgyan mchog thob pa'i mod// ba spu'i ljon pa gar stabs g.yo ba dang*// 'dren byed chu shel dag byed rgyun 'bebs dang*// sor mo'i yal 'dab mdud pa dus mnyam gyur// thog med 'khor mtshor 'phyan pa'i rmongs rgan bdag /snyigs mtha'i skabs skyes mtha' khob gling gnas shing*// mi tshe'i nyi ma nub ri'i rtser babs kyang*// gtan 'dun gdengs tshad ma thob gyi nar lus// srid pa'i snang tshul go yang srid bag chags// bsra 'thas snying la rtsi thebs lto gos don/ 552)/kho nas mi tshe 'das la 'gyod pa'i rgyus// mi med nags mtha' 'dir 'chi bsgugs bzhin gnas// 'chi bar nus pa'i gdengs brod ma mchis kyang*// rang gzhan gnyis phung sgrub pa'i bla gzugs dang*// nag po brtsegs pa'i dkor zas la 'jigs pas// slad mar ser gzugs gral dpon mi skyer smon// bgrang bya'i khur non mgo skyes zla zhun byugs// kha so'i gral zhig khram ris gdong la btab// de phyir 'dir snang bsring blo'i snying stobs ni// med pa'i rgan por brtse bas gzigs mdzad gsol// 'di bzung tshe rabs phreng ba gar skyes kyang*/ chos ltar bcos pa ma yin yang dag chos// ji bzhin spyod 'grub mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon// rnyed 'tshol med pa'i don gnyis 'grub byin rlobs// ces zhu yig gi rjing bur spyan ras kyi ngang mo 533)'bebs rten dang*/ sku tshe bskal brgyar brten par gsol ba 'debs pa'i maṇḍal mtshon byed tsam du/ bkra shis pa'i kha btags/ gos gser ma de 'brel/ bo dhi tse'i phreng ba/ gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ byi ru/ 'jang gi gser rgyan/ sku 'chings dang bcas pa'i dgu tshan la rtags kyis tshom bus bkra bar mgo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba thog mar 'char ba'i tshes la shar phyogs dpal ri'i gangs 'dabs rgod phug mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang nas bya bral ba sna tshogs rang grol gyis gus pas phul ba'i zhu yig

ces pa 'di sgam po mchog gi sprul sku la phul ba'o// ༈ bka' brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gangs ri las// legs 'ongs zab rgyas chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gter// mnga' bsgyur rgya ston klu dbang smin grol gyi// gdengs ka mngon par mtho ba'i rnam 'dren brgyud// tshar du dngar ba'i mdo 'dzin chos kyi rje/ 554)/bstan la lhag par phan pa'i thugs kyi zla// cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge mtshan ni// sngon dang da lta phyi ma'i mthar thug bar// yang dag gsal ba'i sgron ma gang nyid kyis// dag snang rab 'byams lang tsho dar ba'i dpyid// yang dag gzigs pa phyogs su lhung min pa'i// rnam thar gdul bya'i me long dwangs pa'i nang*// mngon par 'char ba dam pa'i chos nyid de// deng 'dir mtha' khob kong rong nags ljongs su// rgyal ba'i khyab bdag padma sam bha wa'i// ring lugs sa bon tsam 'dzin chos kyi grags// 'dren pa bgyi ba'i nus pas dben bzhin du// 'dren pa'i zol dang slar yang dben pa'i rir// nyer bsten sna tshogs rang grol ming 'chang ba'i// rgan po gang la mos pa'i thugs 'khrungs pas// legs par 'doms pa'i rtsom yig glegs bam dang*/ byin rlabs rten bzang skyes su srings 555)zhig pa'i// bka' mchid 'phags pa'i ming 'dzin gso rig pa// gang de'i phrin yig rten bzang bcas smin pas// e ma chen po'i go sar legs bzhugs pa'i// skyes chen de ltas dman sprang bdag 'dra bar// 'dus pa'i 'os min 'dud tshul de ci ko// zhes snyam som nyi'i 'khyogs la 'di na 'chang*// de lta mod kyi skyes chen dam pa'i bka'// ji mi snyam par 'jog pa'i gnas min phyir// mchid lan drang por phul la nyes med pa// bdag 'dra'i ngang tshul mdo tsam gsol la dgongs// sngon gyis legs byas 'ga' las byung ba'i rten// dal 'byor tshang thob lo lngar bstan la zhugs// sdig pa'i bag chags ma mchis thos bsam gyi// sa bon tsam zhig dam pa'i drin las bgyis/

556) /rang lo brgyad nas sgom gyi ngo bo mthong*// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin phra mo shar// 'jig rten chos brgyad zhen pa ngang gis chung*// don rgyud byin rlabs zhugs pa'i bu chung lags// bslab gsum legs zhus kha na ma tho spangs// bag med spyod pa'i ngang du 'chor ma myong*// rang rgyud dul la nyams len snying por bgyis// shāka thub bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren ma byas lags// nyer gsum lo nas smra bcad 'dag sbyar byas// gnyid dang snyom las rang gis rang bslu ba'i// spyod pas ma bslad drug cu re gcig bar// dben mtshams kho nas mi tshe 'da' ba lags// lto phyir grong 'khyams ma byas 'gyod med grub// rkang bzhi zhing dang go mtshon dkon mchog dkor// gshin rdzas dkor zas spong ba'i dam bca' dang*// nor phyir chos mi 'tshong ba'i dam bca' lags// rdzun zog mi 'tshong gzhan la kun slong spong*// dag snang phyogs 557) med grub mtha' mi rtsod cing*// 'brel tshad ci nus dge la sbyor ba dang*// gang byung bla ma'i thugs rjer khyer ba lags// nad la mo bon rtsis gsum mi bsten cing*// dge rtsa srog gcod las dang 'dres mi byed// dge sbyor ma lus mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngo// 'di dag bdag gi rnam thar snying po lags// 'jig rten pher yong med cing lang tsho rgud// dbang po mi gsal 'du ba'i nad kyis zin// myur du 'chi bar go zhing 'gyod 'tsher med// bdag gi rnam thar mtha' ma 'di kar zad// thos bsam sbyangs stobs ma mchis bka' 'bum lags// mkhas rnams khrel ba'i rgyu las mi 'byung bas// de las rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' 'bum tshogs// gzigs dang 'chad nyan 'bri sogs ya mtshan che// nam 'chi cha med myur du 'chi nges pa'i// mi rgan tshe 'di khyed zhal mi mjal gyi/ 558)/ phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams rdo rje'i theg /tshul bzhin spyod par dkyil 'khor gcig tu smon// de skad sha chang bud med dri mas dben// la nyung skyo tsha tshod mas nyer 'tsho'i gnas// chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i sgom khang nas// bya bral rgan bus phul ba'i zhu yig lags//

༈ bskal bzang 'dren pa stong gi gser ri'i dbus// thugs rje'i stobs mchog rmad byung zas gtsang sras// gang de'i bstan pa'i ba dan 'dzin pa la// 'jigs bral mthu stobs dpal mnga' rgya ston mtshan// bka' rgyud dpag bsam ljon pa'i skyed tshal dbus// tshogs gnyis 'bras bus g.yur za'i dge legs dpyid// chos kyi spyan ldan chos rgyal chos kyi rje// gang gis zhabs zung bkra shis 'khor lo'i drung*// nyi 'og shar phyogs ljon pa'i tshal khrod nas// snga 'gyur 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa'i gzhung*/ 559 /ma nyams tsam du 'dzin pa'i chos kyi grwa'i// nye char gnas pa'i rgan pos 'di skad zhu// skye bar legs byas rgya mtshor goms pa'i mthu// mi dman chos kyi dpal 'byor chos bzhin du// spyod mkhas thar pa'i ded dpon khyed sku'i lhun// gzhig bral rdo rje'i khri la mngon brjid bzhin// don bzang bka' mchid rin chen sgrom bu ni// lha gos lhub chen sa zla'i phur mar bcas// ma nyams phyag rgya'i 'ching bas legs btab pas// shānta'i gnas chen nas brgyud spyi bor phebs// 'di na bgrang lo'i khur gyis lci ba'i lus// dbang tshogs stobs nyams 'byung 'khrugs nad kyis gzir// g.yar khang hrul po ma 'gyel tsamakho nar// dge sbyor brtson pa ma dor ngang la gnas// bstan pa'i mtha' ma gzugs 560)brnyan tsam nyid la// chos su rloms pas sa steng gang na yang*// chos bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma ltar// zad 'dir zang zing nor phyir mi tshe 'di// g.yeng la bdag yid ma rangs blo ma bde// sgyu lus 'tsho tsam de ltar byas kyang rung*// dad zas khur pos rang gzhan ngan 'gror mnar// de phyir dkor zas spangs nas lo bcu 'das// rang nyid gar skye'i rang dbang ma thob bzhin// gshin po'i rdzas la rngams pa'i bla gzugs 'di// rang mgo rang gis bslu bar thag chod pa'i// tshul la legs bsam gshin dkor bdag gis spangs// de phyir lhag bsam bzang po'i smon lam ni// mkha' mnyam 'gro la rtag par btab lags na/

'brel thogs ltos bcas rnams la lta ci smos/ bla med rdzogs byangakho nar smon lags so// gnas skabs mthar thug byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi// brtag pa'i lung bstan lkog gyur gnas 561)de dag /ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis spyod yul las/ bdag 'dra so skye'i yul du ga la gyur// de skad rang tshul gang yin zol med du// zhus 'dir khyed thugs mi rnyog bzod bzhes nas// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i phrin las nyid// sngon bzhin phyi ma'i mu mthar 'phel mdzad gsol// zhu yig 'degs rten sgyu ma'i nor rdzas rigs// bdag la mi 'byor khyed la mi ltos phyir// byin rlabs dam rdzas myong grol a mṛ ta// 'di nyid sku tshe'i rten 'byung phul ba lags// sa mo bya lo rgyal zla'i tshes bzang por// kong yul thang 'brog 'od gsal rtse mo yi// ri khrod dben pa'i bsam gtan khang bu nas// sna tshogs rang grol rgan pos phul ba dge// zhes pa'i le tshan gong 'og gnyis po 'di/ mdo khams stod kyi rgya ston chos rje'i drung du phul ba'o// 562)༈ rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs gzhan phan rdo rje yi// zhabs zung spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang mchog /rig pa 'dzin dbang nam mkha' rdo rje'i mtshan// gsang gsum dkyil 'khor 'chang ba gang nyid kyis// legs gsungs yi ge'i gzugs su rnam bkra ba// sman mchog bzang po'i dri ldan phur mar bcas// mi gzhig phyag rgyas bkra bar mtha' 'khob kyi// dben rigs rgan po'i sor rtser legs smin lags// 'di na lang tsho'i me tog lo yis rnyings// gzhan don byed blo'i khur po dus kyis phogs// spros med 'dag sbyar khang bur sgyu ma'i lus// ma zhig tsam du gsol 'debs dmar bar gnas/ ched zhus/ bla ma'i drung nyid sku'i 'tsho ba gser ltar bzang zhing thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs pa shin tu bka' drin che/ phyag tham rten bcas phebs 'byor gyi don cha ltar/

sku mtshams lam lhongs kyi rnam pa de bzhin byung ba ni/ gtso bor legs 563)nyes thams cad sngon gyi las 'ba' zhig gis bskos pa rgyu 'bras slu med kyi chos can kho na las ma 'das pas na/ lhongs 'tshub tu snang ba'i rigs gang yang rgyu sngon las kyi 'bras bu dang*/ rkyen sems byung gi snang ba las gzhan mi 'byung la/ des na ji skad du/ zhing dang dngos po bsam pa gsum// gcig tu dril la gsol ba thob// bar chad kun dang bral gyur nas// dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin tshe/ bar chad du snang ba'am dngos grub tu snang ba sogs mdor na cir snang sems kyi rol pa las ni 'das pa med/ sems nyid ma bcos rjen pa'i rang ngo hrig ge ba 'di ni lha dang bla ma'i ngo bo dngos yin la/ 'di phyi bar do tsam du ma zad mthar thug byang chub kyi bar nam du'ang nyams su len rgyu'i snying po ni bla ma 564)chos kyi sku rang rig pa'i ye shes rang ngo shes par bya ba gcig pu yin/ de la ni bar chad yin na'ang yin la dngos grub yin na'ang yin te/ cir snang bla ma/ gang byung thugs rje/ snang srid dkyil 'khor/ thams cad chos nyid kyi rol pa 'ba' shig ye nas kyang yin la/ da lta nyams su yang de ka ltar blangs pas/ mthar yang de'i klong du grol bar 'gyur tshe/ bar chad la bar chad du 'dzin mi dgos te/ dngos grub tu blangs pas chog don la de gnyis ka sems las gzhan min pa'i phyir ro/ 'on kyang bag chags 'khrul pa'i las snang gis lhag ma tsam du gnod byed kyi rnam par 'char rgyu 'dug na/ sngon gyi lan chags sbyong phyir du byams snying rje zhe thag pa nas bsgom zhing*/ byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'khod par smon lam bzang po gdab pa gal che ba lags pas/ de ltar thugs 565)la bcags 'tshal// ༈ bla ma'i thugs rjes bsdus pa rdo rje'i mched// nam mkha' rdo rje 'di phyi bar do gsum// bla ma rang sems dbyer med nyams len la// rtse gcig blo thag rbad kyis chod mdzad zhu// sa khad 'gyangs shing na so'i khur gyis lci// nam 'chi cha med tshe 'dir mjal ba dka'// phyi mar dag pa'i zhing mchog padma 'od// padma rgyal po de drung 'dzom smon lags/

zhes dam rdzas myong grol dang bcas te/ shar phyogs kong rong ljon pa'i nags khrod/ chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i sgom khang nas phul ba maṅga lam// zhes gtsang snang stod kyi bla ma gru khur ba nam mkha' rdo rje la phul ba'o// ༈ dam pa'i gdung las dam pa'i skyes chen 'khrungs// rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba'i rnam thar skyong*// yang dag lam la yang 566)dag legs brtson pa'i// skyes chen dam pa skyes mchog gang zhabs drung*// mtha' khob tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i mun khrod nang*// las lus dkor gyis 'tsho ba'i rmongs rgan des// yid dbang mgo skyes lhan cig dkar ba yis// btud de mol 'chid tshig gsum gsol la dgongs// gang gi mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer kun gsal phyogs// ris su ma chad mtha' khyab 'gengs pa las// mun gling bu ga chung ngu 'dir yang khyed// brtse ba'i zer 'phreng 'gyed 'di e ma tshar// bka' mchid baiḍūr dkar po'i bum bzang ni// nges gsang snying po'i bcud btams lha rdzas dang*// dri bzang bzhon pa zung gis legs btegs nas// rgan po'i snying gis bdud rtsir yang dag thob// chen po'i go sar bzhugs kyang dman pa la// lhag par brtse 'di dam pa'i 567)mtshan nyid du// gsungs kyang snyigs dus dam pa ches dkon na// de yi mtshan nyid khyed las gang gis ston/ ga ge'i skye sprul yin zhes khas 'che yang*// las nyon bag chags 'thib pos ma sangs bzhin// dad zas me 'dag 'gam la gre yangs po'i// sprul mtshan 'dzin rnams khyed dang mtshungs ma gyur// skye ba du mar legs sbyangs gsung rab don// bcol po'i nor la rang nyid lan bzhin gyi// thos bsam rnam dpyod de lta'i ngo mtshar la// ye shes spyan ldan sras bcas rgyal kun mkhyen// mang du thos pa tshig la ma yin gyi// don gyi snying po lon la mang thos zhes// lang gshegs mdo ru rgyal bas legs bsngags pa// ji bzhin sngar mdzad yi rangs slad du'ang mkhyen// snyigs ma'i nyes stobs dar ba'i dus

568)ngan 'dir// dge legs nya rgyas gzhom pa'i rwa hu la// rnam gyur 'jug sgo mang bas thugs dam gyi// mel tshe g.yel med zhu zhes snying nas gsol// sngon bsags dge 'bras dar ba'i lo tog kyang*// blo bur sad ser than rkyen rigs mang por// mi 'jigs bsrung skyob snying por dkon mchog gi /thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs la brtson zhu// rgyal gsungs chos sgo'i rnam grangs skar tshogs las// mang yang tshe gcig nges legs ster nus pa// sgrub rgyud pad tshal snying po'i mngar bcud la// rang gzhan dgyes dgur rol mdzad bka' drin zhu// tha snyad lā ba ṇya yi chu gter 'jings// zab kyang thar 'dod skom gdung sel nus dka'// yid skyob yan lag brgyad ldan snyan brgyud chus// thugs kyi bum bzang 'gengs rtsol mi bsnyel mkhyen// sbyangs stobs rtsal 569)gsum rdzogs pa'i gdong lnga khyed// 'chi med bu mo'i skyed tshal mi dbang bas// sgrub rgyud nyams rtogs g.yu ral ngom pa'i grwar// kai la sha yi khri 'phang bsten par gsol// rgyal bstan go la 'khor lo'i gros 'dra ba// sgang gshongs nges med 'di ni 'dus byas kyi// chos nyid lags na nyid thugs ri rgyal dang*// kun snyoms nam mkha'i ngang tshul la gnas zhu// 'khor 'das snang tshul sgyu ma rmi lam la// bden zhen rtag par bzung na ngal ba'i rgyu// thams cad sems kyi rol par thag chod pa'i// gdengs chen yang dag zung zhes snying nas gsol// de skad zhu mchid yi ge'i gzugs 'phreng du// 'god par rlom yang mig dbang nus zad pas// zhu yig srin bu'i rjes shul 'dra 'di la// mi khrel don la dgongs dpyad mdzad par gsol/ 570) /zhu yig gcer bu min tsam phyi tshas la// rgya mdzes chu stod nya ba'i dus bzang por// nyi 'og ljon khrod sgrub 'dra'i yang dben nas// rang grol ming 'dzin rgan pos phul zhu yig/ ces pa 'di ni/

mkhyen pa'i pad tshal rab tu yangs shing skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar dri bral du spyod pa'i sprul pa'i sku mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi 'od ces bya ba'i drung du phul ba'o// ༈ snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin rlom pa// mang yang chos brgyad mnga' thang bsgrub pa las// tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma ni// dge legs 'od snang gsal ba gang de'i drung*// rmi lam las kyang rmi lam chen po yi// rnam par 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul snyigs dus kyi// yul snang la skyo'i rgan po se bo des// gus pa'i mol mchid srin rjes 'dra 'di gsol// grangs med tshogs chen gyis bskrun sku'i 571)ljon pa// rab rgyas thos bsam bsgom pa'i yal 'dab 'bras// g.yur za skal bzang mchog 'ga'i gdung skyobs las// phal gyi spyod yul min pa'i pho brang nas// legs 'doms bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bka' glegs bu// byin rlabs dri bzang phon chen lnga brgya'i skyes// rgan po'i chu bur gsal byed phur mar bcas// ma lus yid 'dod 'jo ba'i dpal mchog thob// e ma dam par btags kyang dam pa yi// mtshan nyid kyis dben dam 'dra'i zol mkhan rnams// bag yangs spyod pa'i yul dus gnas skabs kyis// khyod thugs skyo bar ma gyur 'tsho bzhes sam// yang dag thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba las// gzhan pa'i khur gyis ma non spos glang khyed// pha rol phyin drug mche bas mdzes bzhin par// rim gnyis sā la'i nags 572)nang bde bar rgyu// rnam dpyod mnyen lcug sna zhags ring po la// dgon hrul chos brgyad lcags kyus ma btab par// rang zas ke ta ka yis legs 'tsho ba// da ni nges 'byung yid can smon pa'i gnas// ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang yang 'tsho ba'i ched// gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra kun grags pa'i don// rnam 'dren go sa 'dzin rnams zang zing phyir// de lta'i 'ching bas ma bcings khyod kho nar// nges na bsod nams mtho bzhin bsod nams ni// yang dag spel slad yang dag 'bad pa'i rgyun// dam pa'i spyod pa dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig

/rnam pa kun tu rnam par 'phel bar mdzod// ces/ zhu yig mi 'khyar ba'i rten tsam dang bcas ste/ smin drug gi zla ba rang sar 'gyur ba'i drag po'i tshes la/ pakṣu nā dis nye bar 'khyud pa'i ri bo'i spo nas phul ba i thi'/ 573)

zhes pa 'di yang sprul pa'i skyes mchog de nyid la phul ba'o// ༈ gang zhig skye dgu'i 'dren par khas 'che ba'i// sprul pa'i sku zhes mchan snyan 'dzin mang yang*// nges par 'gro ba'i don la rab sman pa'i// sprul mchog mtshan don mthun zhabs padmo'i drung*// rgas dang dad pa lhan cig gis bkugs pa'i// lus dbang smyig ma'i ljon pa ches dud pas// sor bcu'i mdud sbyar snying gar bsdam bzhin du// rgan skad 'dzer ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol la dgongs// mtshan dpa'i sku dang brgyad khri bzhi stong gsung*// mkhyen brtse'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje gsum// ye shes 'khor lo bzod nas rnam dag la// sgrib g.yogs skabs ci gzi 'bar lham me nas// tshad med thugs rje ris su ma 574)chad kyang*// brtse ba'i gzigs pa sbubs kyi chu rgyun bzhin// bdag gcig kho nar rgyun mi chad stsol ba// khyed kyi ngang tshul 'di drin ci yis gzhal// de phyir deng yang rgan po 'chi med kyi// go sar bgod pa'i byin rlabs dpe bral 'dis// 'dus byas mi rtag rtag pa'i mtshan nyid du// bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul mthu can khyod las su// 'di na mi rgan 'gro bar nges bzhin du// 'dug pa'i chis 'dra'i khang chung brtsig bshom gyi// g.yeng ba'i 'khor lor grogs rnams bkod nas kyang*// rang nyid dben pa'i lam du nyal te mchis// chos la chos spyan sgrib med mnga' gang la// bdag 'dra ldongs pas lam ston ma dgos kyang*// dgongs pa'i gtod phyogs dang bstun lhag bsam gyis// mol mchid sngar nas phul mtshungs 575)slad mar yang*// mkhyen pa'i lha lam gting mtha' dben pa gang*// kun rdzob rdzun snang sprin gyis mi 'gog na// bstan 'gro'i don slad mdzad phrin rgya mtsho'i rlabs// ji ltar 'phyo yang rang las mi g.yo ltar// bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i bka' khyab kyis// khyed thugs zab gsal mkha' dbyings mi rnyog par// rim gnyis ye shes dkyil 'khor phyag rgya che'i// gnas lugs khyab gdal ngang las g.yo med zhu// gzugs sku lha yi gsal mdangs 'gag med ngang*// gang gsung sngags kyi chu rgyun grags stong sgra// rig rtsal chos nyid rol pa dgag sgrub bral// yengs 'khrul thob shor khong 'tshang mi gzhug gsol// slad mar phebs 'os mtho ris chu bo bzhin// brtse

576)bas bskyangs dang mtshungs pa'i 'bul 'os tshogs// mi rgan dbugs kyi rgyun thag ma chad ring*// 'bul dang dngos su mjal ba'ang myur 'grub smon/ zhes/ chu klung chen po lo hi ta dung ltar 'khyil ba'i ngogs kyi ri bo'i spo nas gus pasaphul ba shri yastu/ zhes pa 'di ni/ rje btsun a wa dhū tī pa chen po'i zhabs drung du phul ba'o// ༈ bka' rgyud bstan la bka' rgyud thugs rje'i 'phrul// ye shes sgron mes bstan pa'i sgron me ni// zla bral gdul bya'i gtsug na rab 'bar ba'i// mchog sprul yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs drung du// las lus dkor gyis 'tsho ba'i rmongs rgan ni// mtha' khob tshang tshing khrod du gnas bcas te// snyom las chos su brdzu ba'i gyi na bas// thal sbyar spyi bor bkod nas 'di skad zhu/ 577)/rgyal rnams 'gro ba'i don las gzhan pa yi// mdzad pa nam yang yod pa ma yin tshe// khyod sku nam mkha'i nor bu'i 'od zer ni// mtha' khob mun gling 'dir yang spro mdzad mtshar// byin rlabs bka' yi sgrom bu nges gsang bcud// nyon mongs gdung sel sman mchog phur mar bcas// gzhig med phyag rgya'i mtshan ma legs bkra bar// rmongs rgan mgo skyes dkar po'i rgyan mchog gyur// gang sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs 'od brgya pa// grangs med legs byas du mas bskrun pa la// mi mthun chu khur gyis sgrib go skabs ci// thugs rje'i rol gar lha lam 'gengs la 'dud// sprul pa'i sku yi mtshan snyan 'dzin pa ni// gangs ldan yul ljongs dog por byed na yang*// gsang 578)gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dpal// bstan 'gro'i sgron mar 'bar khyed su yis 'gran// de slad lnga brgya mtha' ma'i yang mtha' 'dir// las nyon rgyu 'bras spyad dang spyod gyur gyi// ma rgan 'khrul tshabs che ba'i smyon ma rnams// ngan 'gro'i g.yang las skyobs phyir zhabs brtan gsol// bdag 'dra bgrang lo'i khur dang zug rngu'i nad// lhan cig sgyu ma'i khang rul steng na 'dzom// tshe 'di'i 'dun mas sna thag mtshams mal du// bsdogs grub khyed zhal tshe 'dir mi mjal yang*// bag chags nying 'khrul skye ba'i 'phreng brgyud ni// ma chad de srid bla zol dkor zan rigs// ma skyes dam chos dri bral spyod pa por// skyer smon dam pa khyed kyis rjes bzung 'tshal//

zhes pa 'di/ rin po che bka' rgyud sgron ma'i drung du phul ba'o// 579)maṅga la yi mtshan can sgrub pa pos// zab mo lta dang rgya chen spyod gzhung gi /grub pa'i mtha' yi rgyu mtshan smros shig ces// yi ges bskul ba'i lan du rang tshul ni// drang por smras 'dir khrel bar ma mdzad cig /mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gzhung 'grel sogs// thos pa rgya mtsho'i gter 'dzin bka' rab 'byams// du ma tshogs pa'i 'dun pa dor yod bzhin// mtha' khob rmong rgan bdag 'drar ci phyir 'dri// chos rnams don dam dbyings su ro gcig kyang*// gnas skabs gdul bya'i skal ngor sna tshogs pa'i// chos sgo grangs med bstan pa'i snying po ru// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su bsdus// rgyu yi theg par 'phags pa'i yul nyid du// 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub zhabs las 580)dbu ma dang*// byams mgon thogs med las brgyud sems tsam zhes// shing rta'i srol chen gnyis su yongs la grags// dbu ma la ni don dam kun rdzob kyi// bden pa gnyis su chos kun bsdus mdzad nas// drang don rgyu 'bras kun rdzob bden pa dang*// nges don gnas lugs don dam bden par ru// shes bya'i chos kun nye bar rdzogs bstan mod// dbu ma'i nang tshan thal 'gyur rang rgyud dang*// rab tu mi gnas la sogs grub mtha'i lugs// du mar mchis mod mthar thug 'gal ba ci// rgya chen spyod gzhung mtshan nyid gsum gsungs te// kun rtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum nyid kyi// kun rtags la yang mtshan nyid chad pa dang*// rnam grangs pa yi dbye ba so so dang*// gzhan dbang la yang dag dang ma dag gnyis// yongs grub la ni 'gyur ba 581)med pa dang*// phyin ci ma log yongs grub gnyis gsungs mod// nang gses dbye ba sha mo'i sgro sul bzhin// bsam mi khyab phyir bdag 'dras ci smra nus// mdor bsdus don la mtshan nyid chad pa yi// kun rtags de ni ri bong rwa la sogs// sgro brtags nyid do rnam grangs kun brtags ni// med bzhin 'khrul ngor snang ba'i chos rnams so// ma dag gzhan dbang bag chags mthu brtas pa'i// yul snang kun yin dag pa gzhan dbang zhes// sangs rgyas zhing sogs ye shes snang ba'i rgyan// yongs su grub la 'gyur ba med pa ni// gdod ma'i gnas lugs 'pho 'gyur bral ba dang*// phyin ci ma logs pa yi yongs grub ni// 'khrul pa'i rang 'tshang rig pa'i ngo bo nyid// de ltar brda tsam 'di ru smos pa las// zhib rgyas smra ba

582)bdag 'dra'i yul ma yin// smras kyang grub mtha'i bzhed pa tha dad rnams// mgu dang rjes su yi rang ga la mdzad// de bas mi smra'i brtul zhugs kho na legs// yang yang 'o skol sgrub rgyud zab mo'i lam// brjod bral lhan skyes gnyug ma'i ye shes nyid// rang bab skyong la grub mtha'i khag med kyi// rang rig bzo med bskyang ba mi legs bsam// sangs rgyas mngon du ma gyur de srid du// grub pa'i mtha' la zad pa ma mchis shing*// brjod bral lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur tshe// grub dang ma grub mtha' dang dbus 'dzin gyi// bon chos byis pa'i bye ma'i khang bu ni// brtsig dang 'jig pa'i rtsol sems dga' sdug bsngal gis// rang gis rang nyid ngal zhing tshi chad rgyu// tha snyad tshig gi mtha' la bskal pa brgyar// sbyangs shing grub mtha' phyogs re'i kha 'dzin la/ 583)/dgag rtsod shi la thug pa byas na yang*// ngar 'dzin 'gong po'i go 'phang je mthor 'gyur// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di// gzhig slad rgyal bas bdag med chos rnams bstan// grub pa'i mtha' la bdag tu bzung byed na// de la bdag med chos kyi ci zhig bya// skyo tsha phor gang tsam gyi zhim mngar dang*// tshig zur mtho dman tsam yang mi theg bzhin// rgya chen gzhung lugs grub mtha'i kha bshad ni// shes kyang de la ya mtshan ci zhig che// snyigs ma'i mthar thug ngan rtags bco brgyad tshang*// bstan pa'i mtha' ma gzugs brnyan spyod la re// 'di 'drar rang sems nang du mi 'gugs na// grub mtha'i dgag sgrub da ni a thang chad// khyad par mnyam med dwags po bka' rgyud 'dir// mos gus 584)gsol 'debs byin rlabs lam la brten// rang rig gnyug ma'i rang 'gros skyong ba las// lta grub tshig mtha' gcod pa'i chos lugs min// mchog sprul zla 'od gzhon nu mngon sum du// bzhugs der mos gus ci gsungs dang len 'bad// lam mchog phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyid// zhu bar mi byed gang de phung bar zad// sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma bzhugs dus su// mnyam 'grogs le lo'i bdud kyis khyer ba na// nam zhig gdung 'bum mjal skor byed pa de// 'gyod kyang phyis par 'gyur ro shes ldan dag

/de skad yi ge'i lam du bkod pa 'di// grub mthar rmongs pa'i rgan po spong ba pa// padma legs grub ces byas dben khang nas// phul 'dis khyed thugs khrel bar ma gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni/ gnas chen ri bo shānti'i sgrub pa po zhig gis 585) dbu sems gnyis kyi dbye ba gang yin gyi dri yig lan du bsrings pa'o// ༈ na ma sarba buddha gu ru ratna bhyaḥ gzod ma nyid nas mngon par byang chub kyang*// gdul bya 'dul phyir sna tshogs phrin las kyi// 'gro la phan dang bde ba'i mchog stsol mkhan// rtsa ba brgyud bcas bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bon chos dbyer med dag snang mkhyen rab kyi// gzigs pa yang dag mnga' ba'i bla ma khyed// nges don zab mo'i gleng mo gnang ba la// lan gyi rnam pa mdor bsdus 'di 'bul lo// sems can khams dang dbang po skal ba dang*// mos pa'i bye brag sna tshogs mtha' yas la// rgyal ba rnams kyi chos kyang mtha' yas pa// bsam gyis mi khyab bgrang ba'i yul las 'das// de dag kun gyi snying po nyer bsdus na// drang don nges 586)don gnyis su 'du ba las// drang don rgyu 'bras gtsor ston thun mong chos// rim gyis thar pa'i lam du dkri bar byed// nges don myur lam tshe gcig byang chub la// 'dod pa'i chos la'ang rnam grangs mang mod kyang*// skabs 'dir nyid kyis phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhi'i// 'phros pa mdzad phyir de tshul cung zad 'bul// 'di dang gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum// gdod ma'i gnas lugs gzhi yi ngo bo la// 'khor 'das 'khrul grol sangs rgyas sems can sogs// tha dad med kyang mkha' las sprin byung ltar// gzhi snang rang gis rang ngo ma rig pa'i// 'khrul pa blo bur byung bas rang ngo sgribs// dbul po'i khyim gyi rang ngo gter bzhin du// rang la yod kyang ma shes sdug bsngal bsngal myong*// kun gzhi bag chags sna tshogs nyon mongs pa// gcig

587)las gcig 'phel rmi lam 'khrul snang bzhin// 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor med bzhin snang ba'i chos/ 'gro ba rigs drug khams gsum sdug bsngal bsngal yul// thar med zo chu'i khyud mo lta bur 'khor// rgyal rnams thugs rje phrin las ci mdzad kyang*// ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can tshan che zhing*// rang ngo ma rig nying 'khrul a 'thas pas// thar ba'i dus med 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul lags// ma 'khrul gdod ma'i gnas lugs phyag rgya che// bder gshegs snyingapo chos khams dge ba zhes// ngo bo stong la rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// rtsal mdangs 'gag med cir yang 'char ba las// 'char mkhan 'char rgyu tha dad ma yin pas// dbyer med stong gsal zung 'jug 'dus ma byas/ 588)/sangs rgyas thugs dang sems can khams dbyer med// 'di ni phyag rgya chen po'i gdod ma'i gzhi// gzhi de mngon gyur bya thabs lam gyi rim// bsam gyis mi khyab gdul bya'i dbang rim ltar// thun mong theg par pha rol phyin drug 'bad// sngags kyi theg par rim gnyis skyed rdzogs sgom// de la'ang rgyud sde'i rim pas lam sna tshogs// rgyal rnams thabs mkhas thugs rjes bstan pa'i phyir// gang la mos bzhin nyams blangs des 'grub mod// de las khyad par phyag chen zab lam 'dir// 'khor bar zhen bral nges 'byung bsam pa can// khyad par theg chen blor shong gang zag gis// tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng bya byed mtha' dag dor// nges don grub pa'i bla ma mtshan ldan la// sgo gsum gus pas mnyes gsung sgrubs 589)nas kyang*// kha zhe mthun pas zab mo'i gdams pa zhu// dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam nas thar pa sgrub// 'chi ba mi rtag sgoms pas long med dran// las 'bras bde sdug bsngal shes pas spangs blangs 'bad// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsngal bsam nas zhen pa zlog /dkon mchog skyabs yul gsal gdab skyabs 'gro 'bungs// 'gro kun pha mar go bas byang sems dang*// snying rje smon 'jug byang sems rgyud la sbyangs// thog ma med nas las ngan sdig sgrib kun// rdor sems yig brgya'i sgom bzlas zab mos sbyangs// sangs rgyas thob pa bla ma la rag cing*// bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs dgos pas// byin rlabs de yang mos gus nyid la rag

/mos gus ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma de// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 590)'dus kho na ru// blo thag rbad kyis chod par ma byas na// zol 'grogs mi chos ngo srung tsam gyis ni// byin rlabs tshul bzhin rgyud la 'jug mi 'gyur// des na 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar// skyid sdug bsngal legs nyes bzang ngan ci byung yang*// gtan gyi 'dun ma bla ma kho nar bskyur// spyi bor bsgom la snod bcud bdag lus dang*// longs spyod gtan 'dun ma lus maṇḍal phul// mchi ma g.yo ba'i mos gus gdung shugs kyis// gsol ba drag po snying nas rtse gcig gdab// sku gsung thugs las bdud rtsi'i 'od zer byung*// rang gis gnas gsum thim pas sgo gsum dang*// shes bya'i sgrib pa kun dag byin rlabs zhugs// bum gsang sher ye tshig dbang yongs rdzogs thob// bla ma 'od zhu rang la gnyis med thim// 'khor 'das dus gsum rnam 591)par rtog pa'i tshogs// rba rlabs chu la thim bzhin spros med dus// mnyam par bzhag cing dge ba 'gro la bsngo// de ltar sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor nyams len rnams// khrid rim kun dang khyad par phyag rgya cher// gnad bsnun ma byas nyams rtogs 'byung mi 'gyur// gnad bsnun rtags thon 'bad pa gal du che// lam gyi dngos gzhi phyag rgya chen po la'ang*// mthar thug 'dra yang gnas skabs phyag bzhes kyi// khrid tshul rim pa mi 'dra bsam yas kyang*// 'di ni lhan cig skyes sbyor lug ltar brjod// de la zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis kyis khrid// zhi gnas la yang mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis// mtshan bcas la yang dag dang ma dag gi /ma dag shing bu rde'u la brten dang*// dag pa 592)ye shes lha dang rlung sems la// brten pa la sogs sems kyi gnas cha btsal// mtshan med dmigs rten med par gnas pa sogs// rnam rtog bag chags g.yo ba'i rba rlabs nyid// rang babs rang sar zhi ba'i thabs la 'bad// zhi gnas sgom gyi dngos gzhi ma yin kyang*// bsam gtan gzhi rten lhag par gal che zhing*// shin tu 'bad na g.yo thob goms brtan gyi// lam rtags rnams dang shin sbyangs 'bras bu yis// ting 'dzin nyin zhag 'da' dang mngon shes 'char// zas skom mi dgos la sogs rtags shar yang*// khengs rlom zhen 'dzin mi bya g.yas med bskyur// zhen na lha bu'i bdud kyi bslu zhing phung*// dga' brod zhen 'dzin med pa gal du che// zhi gnas goms rjes lhag mthong rtogs pa'i phyir/

593)/sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum gdar sha bcad// sems la dngos po mtshan ma ma grub cing*/ kha dog dbyibs dang ngos bzung ma mchis la// med pa'i stong chad ma yin rig cing gsal// gsal stong tha dad ma yin gnyis med ngang*// 'di bzhes brjod du med la rig tu yod// rig mkhan rig rgyu gnyis su ma yin par// rang gi rang ngo shes shing rig pa de// lhag mthong zhes bya sems ngo mthong ba yin// zhi gnas dus kyi gnas pa'i ngo bo dang*// tha mal dus kyi rnam rtog rang dga' ma// thams cad lhag mthong 'di dang dbyer med kyang*// byin rlabs ma zhugs bar du ngo ma shes// 'di nyid ngo mthong lta ba rtogs ces bya// sgom rgyu'i ngo bo'ang 'di las gzhan med cing*// blo yis bcos nas sgom rgyu 594)ma yin tshe// sems kyi 'dug tshul 'char tshul gang yin de// mi dgag mi bsgyur de rjes mi 'brang bar// rang gis rang rig hrig ge rjen ne bzhag /bzhag rgyu 'jog mkhan logs su ma mchis kyang*// gang ltar shar ba dgag sgrub mi bya zhing*// de yi dbang du phar la mi 'chor bar// rang rig rang 'tsho zin par skyong ba la// yang dag dran pa zhes su brjod pa yin// 'di nyid ma yengs skyong la mnyam gzhag zer// 'gro 'dug bya byed kun dang bsre thub na// rjes thob ces bya don la khyad par med// rang ngos ma zin gnas kyang mnyam gzhag min// 'khor 'das so mtshams rig dang ma rig nyid// rig na sangs rgyas ma rig sems can yin// de phyir rig pa ma yengs gnad du ched// de yi 'phro la rnam rtog tshogs drug dang*// nyon mongs 595)la sogs gang dang ci shar yang*// de dbang mi btang gnyen po gzhan mi btsal// byis pa'i rtsed mor rgan pos lta ba bzhin// g.yas med gnyer med 'dzin med kho nar bskyur// goms tshe sgyu ma lta bu'i ting

'dzin 'char// lam rtags rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa yang*// gang zag rim gyis pa dang gcig char ba// thod rgal ba sogs so so'i khyad par dang*// nyams len brtson khyad las sgrib srab 'thug sogs// kun la tshad gcig nges pa mi 'byung mod// spyi tsam rim skyes zhig la cha bzhag na// mnyam bzhag 'bad rtsol la rag rtse gcig ma// dran tsam ngo bor sleb pa spros bral dang*// snang sems gnyis 'dzin zad pa ro gcig la// bsgom bya sgom byed bral la sgom med zer// de dag so sor 596)chung 'bring che khyad dang*// re re la yang sna zin pa dang ni// gtan la phebs dang rtsal rdzogs dbye ba sogs// shin tu zhib par sgrub rgyud gong ma yis// gsungs phyir bdag 'dras brjod du ga la mchis// 'gag don snying por bsgom bya'i ngo bo dang*// sgom byed mkhan po so sor ma lus par// rang rig rjen pa ma bcos 'di nyid du// thag chod yongs 'khrul zhen 'dzin med pa na// rnal 'byor bzhi po'i don kun de ru 'du// ding sang bskal pa snyigs ma'i yang mthar thug /chos kun gzugs brnyan tsam la spyod pa'i phyir// phyag chen sgom yang rnal 'byor bzhi rim bzhin// rgyud la skyes pa'i sgom chen rnyed par dka'// gal te tshul bzhin mtha' ru phyin pa na// drod tshad rtags kyi ngos 'dzin bogs 'don sogs// gzhan la ltos med dgos par rang la 597)'char// yengs 'khrul bral bas rtse gcig brtan pa zin// a 'thas zhi na spros bral mngon du 'gyur// gnyis 'dzin zad pas ro gcig lhun gyis grub// 'khrul pa dbyings su nub pas sgom med de// de ltar rgyud la skyes pa'i sgom chen de/ gegs sel bogs 'don gzhan la ga nas re// tshul bzhin mi sgom zhu zhu thob thob tsam// kha chos tshig la 'byams pa'i gang zag la// rnal 'byor gzhi las zhi gnas tshul mthun yang*// rgyud la mi skye'i bshad pas dgos pa ci// rtse gcig skabs su brtson 'grus bogs 'don zhing*// spros bral bogs ni mos gus nyid kyis 'don// ro gcig la ni snying rjes bogs 'don bya// sgom med la ni bogs 'don ci la dgos/

598)/gzhan yang shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum// la sogs 'phra zhib mang po gsungs pa la// nyams rtogs can la shor sa gol sa bral// nyams rtogs med na shor gol 'ong don med// don la 'khor 'das snang srid sems su shes// sems nyid phyag rgya chen por shar ba la// gegs dang nor 'khrul shor gol ga la 'byung*// mos gus gsol 'debs 'bad na gegs dang bral// thun mong theg pa dag dang sgo bstun pa'i// sa bcu lam lnga'i rim pa dang sbyar ba// phyag chen khrid gzhung la lar gsungs mod kyang*// dbang rab skad cig gcig gis sa lam kun// yongs rdzogs chod pas ring lam bskor mi dgos// bya rgyal nam mkha'i dbyings lam gcod pa la// la chu 'phrang gi bgrod rtsol mi dgos bzhin// theg pa'i rtse rgyal myur lam 599)yin phyir ro// de ltar lam gyi nyams len mthar son na// mthar thug 'bras bu sku gsum thob tshul ni// gang zag dbang po rab dang brtson 'grus rab// tshe 'di'i snang ba nub dang dus mnyam du// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur grol ba dang*// 'bring gi bar dor ye shes sku 'grub 'gyur// tha mas skye ba gcig sogs brgyud pa'i mthar// lam gyi lhag ma sbyang bgrod mthar phyin zhing*// dam tshig nyams ltung dri mas gos med na// phyir mi ldog pa chos sku'i gtan srid zin// rang gdangs 'gag med longs sku ye shes kyi// sku dang zhing khams sa bcu'i 'khor la snang*// lam dus sems bskyed smon lam mthu 'bras kyis// gdul bya dag dang ma dag gnas so sor// rang skal dang mthun sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'gro don rtsol med 600)shugs kyi 'byung ba ni// dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor ltar ro// de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul mod tsam// brjod kyi rgya cher bdag 'dra'i yul ma yin// thos bsam sgom pa'i stobs dman dbang tshogs rgud// 'chi bdag zhags pas btab nye tshe 'di yi// 'dun ma nyer bstungs rang shong mal nang du// yang dag 'jog las gzhan pa'i spros pas dben// de phyir mkhyen ldan khyed thugs mgu nus pa'i// legs bshad smra bar bdag 'dras spobs min te// ci nus tsam zhig phul ba'i lhag bsam gyi// dge bas 'gro kun phyag rgya che 'grub shog/

de ltar yang*/ gtsang rta nag ri zhig gi sde dgon chen po nas mkhyen rtogs yon tan gyi spyan dang ldan pa'i chos kyi rje des phyag tham rin po che gser gyi rten gnang dang bcas te bskul bar mdzad mod kyang*/ bdag mi rgan spyir yang dad zas dkor la ci 'dzem 601) dang*/ khyad par deng sang snyigs dus kyi bla rigs phal mo che rnams zang zing nor rdzas sdud pa'i zong rin dbang chos kyi byed pa'i srol ngan 'di bzhin dar ba ni rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam pa'i chos dang 'gal ba'i nyes sgrib shin tu che bar mthong bas/ bdag nyid dam chos bshad pa'i yon du zang zing mi len pa'i dam bca' bgyis nas lo mang song bas na/ gser gyi gnang cha ni ga nas zhu la/ gsung bris kyi mchid lan 'di bzhin 'bul bar yang*/ spyir thos pa dman zhing khyad par nyams rtogs dang mi ldan pas tshul 'di dag gi mchid lan bgyi ba'i nus pa ma mchis pa dang*/ lhag par da ni 'byung 'dus kyi khang rgan 'gyel ma rag gi tshe 'di'i snang ba zhag 'ga' tsam las spyod pa'i long med pa'i dus la babs pa na/ tshig dang yi ge'i spros pa ma mchis na'ang*/ mkhyen ldan khyed kyis chos rgyud dang grub mtha'i phyogs lhung mi mnga' ba'i dag snang gis gzigs pa mi dman 602) par bka' mchid 'di bzhin bstsal ba'i zhal ngo mi bskyung bar lan gyi rnam pa mdo tsam phul ba la/ dgongs par mi 'bab pa'i 'gal 'khrul mchis na chos dbyings sgyu ma'i klong du bzod par bzhes su gsol/ zhes chos dbyings 'od gsal gyi rtse mo byang chub kyi snying po mngon par mtho ba'i yang dben bsam gtan gyi khang bu nas phul ba phyogs dus kun tu dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ dpal ri zhabs drung du phul ba'i zhu yig gang la brten nas 'khor ba ngan song gi /'jigs chen bde blag 'phrog nus thugs rje'i mdzod// dpal ldan padma rgyal po'i ring lugs mchog /'dzin la 'jigs bral rnam 'dren dbang po'i zhabs/

1 /legs btud dang ba'i yid kyis mchid 'di gsol// legs byas 'bum gyis bskrun pa'i mtshan dpe'i skur// gdul bya'i dad pa'i yid kyi me long la// 'grib med gsal la ltar 603)snang nyer 'tshes dben/ 2 /thugs rje phrin las mdzad bzang gaṅga'i rgyun// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i lam gsum bgrod pa dang*// skal ldan las nyon sgrib pa bkru ba yi// rnam thar nges legs chu bo las 'ongs pa'i/ 3 /bka' glegs rin thang che ba'i skyes bzang bcas// byin rlabs bden tshig shis brjod me tog char// rgan po 'chi kha 'chi med ngal stegs la// 'god mdzad bka' drin 'di ko gang gis 'khor/ 4 /mgon khyod spyi dang khyad par bstan pa yi// srog 'dzin ya mtshan mdzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul la// ngal dang g.yel ba'i dri mas cha shas ni// phra rab rdul tsam ma mchis rjes yi rangs/ 5 /deng dus rnam 'dren bstan 'dzin che ge mor// bzhed rnams rang phyogs bstan pa 'ba' shig las// khams gsum mchod pa'i yul gyur gtsug 604)lag la// spyan zur tsam yang gzigs mkhan ma mchis 'dir/ 6 /rgyal ba'i khyab bdag padma thod phreng gi /zhabs pad bkod shul byin rlabs ri mo bkra// de dag slar yang nyin mor byed bzhin du// mdzad dge rnam mkhyen byang chen sgyur smon lags/ 7 /khyed zhabs bskal pa rgya mtshor rab brtan pas// legs spyod 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las rgyun// da dung srid pa'i mtha' mnyam mdzad pa la// gegs med gzhan don 'grub pa'i bkra shis gsol/ 8 /'di na las lus dkor sgrib kyis gdungs pa'i// rgan khog rmi lam mi gzugs lta bu 'di// 'dus byas rang mtshang bstan par gyur gsan na// brtse bas gzigs par gsol zhes zhu ba lags// zhes pa 'di ni/ dpal ri rig 'dzin mchog gi sprul ba'i skur phul ba'o// ༈ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gzhan phan rdo rje 605)yis// dam tshig lug rgyud kyis sbrel rdo rje'i mched// rig pa 'dzin dbang nam mkha' rdo rje nyid// dkyil 'khor gsum ldan g.yo med bzhugs yi rangs// bka' yi phrin yig zhib rgyas don bzang phreng*// sman mchog dri bzang phur ma ches btegs pa// gzhig med phyag rgya'i re kha ma nyams par// shar phyogs ljon khrod 'od gsal rtse mor smin// 'di na 'byung 'dus ches rgud mig dbang 'grib// 'dus byas tshe 'di'i bya ba'i spros rgyun chad// mal du yang dag 'jog las gzhan pa yi// bya ba'i blo sna med par 'chi grabs chud// gzhan don byed pa'i nus stobs zad pa dang*// byas kyang khrims bdag rnams kyis mi dgyes gnyis// phan tshun 'gran pa ji bzhin snang tshul gyis// rnam 'gyur 'di ni rkyen ngan grogs shar nyid// sku nyid dgung los

606)lcid kyang dbang tshogs dwangs// skyes chen dam par chos mchod 'bul ba yi// skal bzang de 'dra bsod nams rab las rab// drin can bla ma'i sku drin 'khor ba lags// rtag tu gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang rig 'di// sgom 'dod blo yis mi bcings mi zhen par// rang babs tshogs drug lhug pa gu yangs ngang*// rang gzhan don kun lhun grub mdzad par zhu// zhu don snying por/ chos dbyings gdod ma'i rang mdangs 'od gsal zhing*// ngo mtshar padma 'od kyi gzhal med khang*// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dbus der// rigs kun khyab bdag padma rgyal po'i drung*// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i rnal 'byor mched// dad dam gtsang ma'i rten 'brel mtshams sbyar te// sgyu lus gog pa'i sbubs las thon ma thag /skyabs mchog rgyal ba de drung lhan cig 'dzom// zag med 'dod yon la spyod ting 'dzin 607)gyi// sgo brgyad 'byed pa'i rol gar phrin las kyis/ mkha' mnyam pha ma kun kyang der 'god pa'i// smon lam bden tshig gegs med 'grub gyur cig/ ces rten 'brel mtshon pa'i bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas/ byang chub sems kyi phreng ba/ byin rlabs dad rten dang bcas pa'i phyi thums la 'gyur med rdo rje'i rtags kyi rgyas btab te nyi 'og tshang tshing khrod kyi ri bo'i spo chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse'i sgom khang nas phul ba dge/ zhes pa 'di/ gtsang nyang stod kyi bla ma gru khur ba gang de'i drung du phul ba'o// ༈ rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'od gsal lha rigs las 'khrungs pa// mkhyen pa'i rnam dpyod 'dab rgya can// lha yi lha khyod shis gyur cig /gang khyed sngon goms legs byas tshogs gnyis kyi// rgyu 'bras gaṅga'i klung lam zhugs rgyun gyis// deng kyang thos 608)bsam smin grol legs lam sgor// 'jug la ngal med mdzad der snying nas bsngags// gang gi thugs bsam dag snang gis// skya rengs dang por shar ba yi// bka' mchid zab gsal phreng brgyud dang*// sman mchog dri bzang ke sa ra// dgra bcom nyi ma'i gung pa yis// byin rlabs phon chen brgya ldan smin// 'di na thos bsam sbyangs 'bras dman na yang*// nges 'byung bsam pa'i stegs la rtag bsten pa'i// 'chi ba snying la zug pa'i rgan 'khogs bdag

/'di snang bya ba'i mig rgyu ngang gis yal// sdig pa'i dug la ma 'bags gdeng yod kyang*// dad zas dkor la spyad che'i 'gyod pa'i rgyus// rgas bzhin dka' thub sgrib sbyong brtson 'grus la// mi lhod ngang nas 'chi ba'i smon pas gnas// lags/ skabs zhus kyi snying por/ dal 'byor phun tshogs rnyed pa 609)'di// don med stong zad mi btang 'tshal// tshe la nges med na gzhon yang*// 'chi ba thog bab 'ong mkhyen mdzod// rgyu 'bras bslu med 'bras bu 'byung*// spang blang zhib ther thon pa zhu// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsngal 'ba' shig la// bde bar 'khrul zhen mi skye 'tshal// rtag tu 'dun ma'i blo rtse kun// bla ma dkon mchog la gtod zhu// chos kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems// rang rgyud 'dul la nan tan 'tshal// so thar byang sems sngags sdom la// nyes ltung dri mas ma gos zhu// dbyibs la lha skur mi 'dzin pa// snod bcud ye nas lhar shes mdzod// blos bcos stong nyid ma yin pa'i// gdod ma'i ka dag mkhyen par mdzod// sems 'dzin 'jur bus ma bcings par// gang shar rang grol skyong bar zhu// kha lta'i rtsings chos 610)mi bya bar// bag yod zhi dul ldan par mdzod// dag snang phyogs med kun la sbyang*// chags sdang kun slong rgyang bsring 'tshal// rang rgyud smin grol gdeng thob tshe// gzhan don skyo dub bral bar mdzod// rnyed bkur nor 'dod ma yin pa'i// byang chen spyod pa rlabs chen mdzod// bstan dang 'gro la phan brtson pa'i// rgyal sras mdzad pa mthar phyin zhu// snying gtam tshig gi phreng ba 'di// zab dbyings rgya mtshor bstim par gsol// zhes byin rlabs dam rdzas myong grol gyi thum bu/ bkra shis pa'i dar dkar sa'i zla ba thum chung dang bcas la rtags kyi bkra bar/ mtha' khob kyi nags ljongs byang chub kyi snying po mngon par mtho ba'i rtse mo nas phul ba'i zhu yig ces pa 'di ni/
mnga' ris gung thang pa'i chos rgyal gdung brgyud dri ma med pa las rim 611) par byon pa'i zhabs drung mnga' bdag rin po che'i zhal ngo zhig la phul ba'o// dge'o// 612)
